package.name: lane_pilot
package.description: Metric lane follower for the Puzzlebot. Projects the camera image to a ground-plane bird's-eye view (inverse perspective mapping), detects the middle line of a 3-line lane, accumulates the centerline in the odom frame so the camera blind spot (the few cm directly in front of the robot) is filled from memory, and tracks it with regulated pure pursuit. Replaces the purely reactive image-space follower for robust tight-curve navigation.
